title: criteria-closure/v1 request
description: The request devtools sends to `spec-runner verify --criteria --request <file> --json` (spec-runner#603 design §4). Two rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the producer: every test_criteria id carries this request's `code`, and no id repeats (whatever its verify_task).

owner_repo.description: `name` or `owner/name`, compared with the source repo's origin. A bare name checks the name only — a repository of that name under any owner matches (a named boundary).

bundle_pin.description: The bundle's approval commit SHA; echoed verbatim, not used.

id.description: A qualified BEH id whose code equals `code`.

verify_task.description: Echoed; no effect since norm rev 8.
